editorial:
Imagine landing your big break on a hit soap opera, only to realize your next-door neighbor is a total stalker. That is exactly what happens to Neely, a hopeful actress who finally gets her foot in the door at Heartbreak Hospital. While Neely is just trying to learn her lines, her neighbor Lottie is obsessed with the show. The problem is that Lottie cannot tell the difference between the scripted drama on TV and real life. What starts as a cute friendship quickly turns into a nightmare as Lottie's jealousy grows, making her a danger to everyone on set. It is a wild ride that mixes laughs with a bit of a creepy edge, keeping you guessing about how far Lottie will go.

You will love how the movie pokes fun at the over-the-top world of soap operas. The acting is great, especially the way Lottie switches from sweet to scary in a heartbeat. The pacing stays quick, so you never get bored. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the fun energy makes up for it. If you are in the mood for something light but tense, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head during a chaotic climax where Lottie tries to force her way into the show's world. She finally snaps and attempts to replace Neely, believing she is the rightful star. After a tense confrontation on set, the cast and crew manage to stop her. Lottie is eventually taken away to get help, and Neely is able to keep her job and move on without her creepy neighbor hanging around.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves campy comedies and stories about obsessed fans.
